svg.text: An imaginary pulsejet, slowed right down
reference sensor: sees the bang at the same time every cycle
moving sensor on the rail: fires when the spike passes it
What the two sensors record in one cycle
time runs left to right from the bang; the trace draws as the cycle plays
delay after the reference spike, against how
far down the inlet the moving sensor was
Pressure along the whole engine, right now
Lined up with the drawing above. The spike leaves the chamber and runs down both tubes;
the moving sensor only ever sees the pressure under the blue dashed line.
